searchText: Who operates https://ethresear.ch? It seems I cannot login with username/password anymore, it wants to force me to GitHub OAuth now? flagged with ef devops haha okay, it looks like this has been the case since 2020 and you have a github login: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595721451651465227/1262318766436651148 It would seem I'm getting old. I wonder why GitHub dropped my OAuth for it and is asking me to go through the process again. That is what triggered my concern, that I got prompted by GitHub to authorize a new application. Do you know why username/password authentication isn't supported? I generally try to avoid OAuth for privacy reasons, which is another reason why I keep bringing this up (rather than just blindly approving). i don't know. i can ask if there's reasoning and if it's open for review
